title: Typed multi-resource ServiceCurve conjunction
hypothesis: A bounded multi-resource materialization is resource-feasible only if every required typed resource independently meets its current-epoch service demand before its deadline; surplus in one unit must never compensate for deficit in another.
falsifiers: exhaustive two-resource conjunction disagrees with direct oracle
cross-unit scalar sum can replace typed conjunction without false admission
one stale required resource fails to invalidate the whole plan
service-unit mismatch does not fail closed
typed conjunction produces a Monte Carlo false admit
